parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
- **true**: performs a dry run without adding the zone. The system checks required parameters, request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
- **false** (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed.

parameters.name: EndpointId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint to which you want to add a zone.

parameters.name: Ipv6Address
parameters.description: The IPv6 address of the endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) in the zone to add. You can specify an active IPv6 address in the vSwitch of the zone. The system automatically assigns an IPv6 address to the endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) from the network interface controller (NIC) if you do not specify one.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the endpoint to which you want to add a zone.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~120468~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch in the zone to add. The system automatically creates an endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) in this vSwitch.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The ID of the zone to add.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: The IP address of the endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) in the zone to add. You can specify an active IP address in the vSwitch of the zone. The system automatically assigns an IP address to the endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) from the network interface controller (NIC) if you do not specify one.
